name: Our World Energy, LLC

about:
Our World Energy, LLC is headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, and was founded in 2016 by Caleb Antonucci. The company began as a bridge connecting solar professionals with homeowners seeking affordable energy independence, later evolving into a direct installer of residential solar systems.

The firm designs and installs photovoltaic systems for single-family homes, using what it describes as locally manufactured solar panel technologies. Its certified solar specialists are cross-trained as roofing experts, allowing the company to handle both the structural and electrical aspects of each installation. Operations span 16 states and territories, including Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Mexico, Puerto Rico, Rhode Island, Texas, Vermont, and Virginia.

The primary customer base is residential homeowners looking to reduce monthly electricity costs and gain energy independence. The company markets its solutions directly to consumers in the listed service areas, emphasizing a transparent, partnership-based sales process.

Our World Energy differentiates itself with a 25-year, no-strings-attached warranty on its installations, a people-first approach that walks customers through every step, and the integration of roofing expertise to ensure precise, tailored system mounting.
